top_story.headline: Secretary of the Army Daniel P. Driscoll Files Termination Report
top_story.dek: The Army's top civilian filed an ethics termination report after leaving office on September 3, 2026.
paragraphs: Daniel P. Driscoll, Secretary of the Army, filed a termination report on October 3, 2026, following his separation on September 3, 2026. The report documents his financial interests at the time of departure. Ten other officials filed routine annual or transaction disclosures in the same period.

sections.headline: No new foreign-agent registrants posted

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.
